description: Permanently delete a blob by blob_id. This operation cannot be undone.
embedding_description: Permanently delete a blob by namespace and blob_id. Use to clean up temporary or obsolete files and reclaim storage; operation cannot be undone. Returns deletion status for confirmation. Best used for ephemeral artifacts or privacy removals.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that blob was permanently deleted
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently deleting a blob from storage by blob_id
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: Blob with given ID does not exist. StorageError: Failed to delete blob from filesystem. PermissionError: Insufficient permissions to delete from storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: verify blob_id is correct. For storage errors: check filesystem health. For permission errors: verify storage directory permissions.
